title: Stream Key stays revealed after the Settings box is left by Share or Leave, so the next Settings shows it without the warning
trigger: Manager opens the live stream window, Settings, Show key and accepts the warning (key_shown = true), then taps Share (line 294 sets overlay = None directly) or confirms Leave (line 491). Later reopens Settings in the same call.
effect: The RTMP stream key is drawn in clear without going through the KeyWarning box again; only close_stream_overlay and StreamWindow::clear reset key_shown.
fix: Make the key reveal part of the overlay enum (StreamOverlay::Settings { key_shown }) so every path that drops the overlay drops the reveal, instead of two fields reset by hand in two of the exits.

title: Stream overlay and key reveal are two fields kept in step by hand
trigger: Any open/close of the stream window boxes.
effect: See P2-001; also the overlay is only cleared by StreamWindow::clear, not by sync_group_call_boxes, so it outlives a changed call while a live PiP keeps the stream.
fix: One enum for the stream window box (none, settings with key hidden/shown, speakers, leave, revoke, warning) owned by the screen, dropped with the call in sync_group_call_boxes.

title: Group call window stage is window: Option plus window_opening: bool plus window_visible: bool
trigger: Open/close/replace the video chat window (open_group_call_window defers the open; sync_group_call_window removes and reopens when the layout changes).
effect: No bug found today: window_opening is cleared in the deferred open on both arms. The stages closed/opening/open(visible|hidden) are three fields.
fix: enum CallWindow { Closed, Opening { stream: bool }, Open { handle, visible, is_stream } }.

title: Stream join is three fields: stream_join intent, stream_joining id and stream_join_timeout task
trigger: Watch a stream or create a video chat; join_stream sets stream_joining and the timeout, settle_stream_join / stream_join_ended / stream_join_failed / sync_group_call_window clear the pair in five places.
effect: No stuck state found: every exit clears both fields, and the task is dropped with the Option. But stream_joining and stream_join_timeout must always be Some/None together.
fix: enum StreamJoin { Idle, Wanted { intent, tracked_then }, Joining { call: i32, timeout: Task<()> } } with one method that leaves Joining.

title: A stream join wish for a call that never gets tracked lingers and can join much later
trigger: Tap a stream link or the chat's video chat button (note_stream_join_intent records Call(id) with tracked_then = None); the call is never tracked (request fails or the user waits). Later, with no other call tracked, the same call is tracked from another entry (e.g. a link to the same call).
effect: consume_stream_join_intent finds the matching intent and joins immediately although the user only meant to look; the wish has no timeout or cancel except close_group_call_window and a different call being tracked.
fix: Give the Wanted stage a deadline (manual clock) or clear it when the request that fetches the call fails.

title: StreamWindow holds several staged fields: hide_armed + hide_task, photo (None while blurring) + photo_task, title_pressed
trigger: Hover/move in full screen (arm_stream_hide_timer), first frame of a stream with a chat photo (group_call_stream_photo).
effect: No bug found: hide_armed is cleared when the loop ends; photo/photo_task are replaced together. A blur that fails leaves (path, None) for good, with no retry (cosmetic).
fix: hide timer as Option<Task> alone (armed iff Some, cleared by the task's last step); photo as Fetch<Arc<RenderImage>> keyed by path.

title: Blurred stream photo is kept after the chat loses its photo
trigger: During a live stream the channel photo is removed (chat_photo_path returns None).
effect: group_call_stream_photo returns at the first ? without clearing StreamWindow::photo, so the picture view keeps the old chat's blurred photo behind the label until the call ends.
fix: When the chat has no photo path, drop the cached photo (and its task) in the same place.

title: Global push-to-talk hook is a controller plus a listener-stop flag plus a polling bool kept in step by sync_global_ptt
trigger: Join a group call with push-to-talk on, switch it off, lose Input Monitoring permission.
effect: No bug found: the stop flag is set whenever the hook is replaced or inactive, global_ptt_polling is cleared by its own task. The three must change together.
fix: enum GlobalPtt { Off, Running { hook, stop }, NeedsPermission { poll: Task<()> } } with the key-capture arming as its own variant of a shortcut-capture enum.

title: Share Invite Link asks for the links and opens the box under the passcode lock
trigger: Lock Quill with a joined video chat (call windows stay usable), press Share in the call window menu or the invite row.
effect: group_call_needs_unlock only raises the main window and its result is ignored: the links request is sent and share_open is set while locked; the box appears at the unlock without being asked again. Other call-window openers refuse with refused_while_locked.
fix: Check refused_while_locked (or queue an unlock intent) in open_group_call_share_links before the request, and return when group_call_needs_unlock is true.

title: Share and invite boxes are bools plus a call id in step
trigger: Open Share Invite Link, then the call changes or the links fail.
effect: No bug found: sync_group_call_boxes closes them when boxes_call changes and when the links are neither generating nor ready. share_open, share_speaker and share_copied are one box's stage.
fix: enum VideoChatBox { None, Invite, Share { speaker, copied } } with the call id inside it.

title: Sharing a call link to a chat overwrites a pending deep-link open
trigger: A deep link is waiting in links.pending_deep_link_open (for example queued while an earlier open is in progress), then the user picks a chat under Share to.
effect: The single Option slot is replaced; the earlier link action is lost without a note.
fix: Queue opens (Vec/VecDeque of PendingOpen) or refuse the share while one is pending.

title: In-call chat visibility and per-participant level animations outlive the call
trigger: Open the in-call chat (Show chat) in a video chat, leave, join another video chat. For levels: a participant sounds then leaves.
effect: chat_shown is never reset (only toggled and initialised), so the next call's window opens with the chat section already shown. row_levels entries are removed only when that row is built again, so a leaver's entry stays for the process and an audio_source_id reused by a later call starts from a stale animation.
fix: Move per-call UI into one CallView value created when a call is tracked and dropped when it ends (sync_group_call_boxes already knows the call id).

title: StageVolume keeps sender, level and a dragging bool beside the slider; dragging is cleared only by a Release event
trigger: Drag the stage volume slider and let the pointer-up land outside the slider/window so no Release event arrives.
effect: dragging stays true, so the slider is never remade when the server level changes, and the entry (app-wide GroupCallUi) also survives call end and account switch until another sender is pinned.
fix: enum StageVolume { Idle { level }, Dragging } owned by the screen's pin, dropped with the call.

title: A failed fetch for the Invite Links, Join Requests or Administrators page shows the loading spinner for good
trigger: Open Group Settings > Invite Links (or Join Requests / Administrators) when the driver cannot send the request (Err is dropped by `let _ = match view`).
effect: The session never gets a Loading/Failed entry, and the sections draw None the same as Loading (spinner). Only the small refresh icon recovers; no error and no Retry button.
fix: Treat an Err from the fetch as Fetch::Failed in the session, and draw None as 'not asked' (ask again) rather than as Loading.

title: Upgrade to supergroup confirm closes the box before the request is answered
trigger: Group Settings > Upgrade > confirm while the driver refuses the request (Err) or returns None.
effect: group_settings_action runs, then close_group_settings_dialog runs regardless; a failure only produces a toast and the user must reopen the box to try again.
fix: Make the upgrade a request stage (Confirm, Sending, Failed(reason)) that closes on the answer or on the pump_chat_upgrades event.

title: A chat window showing a group that was upgraded stays on the dead group when the main window handle is gone
trigger: Open a basic group in a chat window, close or hide the main window so main_window.handle is None, then upgrade the group (from another device or the chat window's box).
effect: move_upgraded_chat_window returns early; the chat window keeps the deactivated basic group, the upgrade event has already been taken by take_chat_upgrades.
fix: Open the replacement window from any live window handle, or retarget the chat window's chat in place.

title: Per-window glyph sweep is pending: Option, sweep_when_idle: bool, kept/seen counters in step
trigger: Idle trim begins a sweep (begin), the next render finishes it (start_frame), a window goes to the background (window_activation).
effect: No user-visible bug found. A pending sweep waits for a render of that window; a window that is hidden and never renders keeps pending (no new sweep for it) until it closes (forget_closed_windows) or draws.
fix: enum Sweep { Idle, Marked(PendingSweep) } plus an idle-trigger enum; or clear Marked when the window reports it is hidden.

title: Giveaway form carries confirming: bool and page enum for what is one wizard stage
trigger: Open Boosts via Gifts, pick Users/Countries pages, tap launch on a prepaid giveaway.
effect: No bug found here (Farewell closes the form on account switch). `confirming` and `page` can both be set; whether the confirm step shows over a list page depends on the renderer.
fix: enum GiveawayStep { Form, Users, Countries, ConfirmPrepaid } (note lives with the step).

title: A failed call window open re-notes the error on every sync
trigger: Join a voice chat on a platform/state where cx.open_window returns Err; sync_call_windows runs every frame/poll, window stays None while the call is wanted, so open_group_call_window runs again
effect: The 'could not open the video chat' note is raised again and again, and an open attempt is made on every sync
fix: Make the window one enum (Closed, Opening, Open(handle), Failed(call id)) so a failed open for a call is remembered and not retried until the call changes.

title: Call window lifecycle as window + window_opening + window_visible + stream.window_is_stream
trigger: Open, hide, close and re-layout the voice chat window
effect: window_visible keeps its last value after the window closes, window_is_stream is only meaningful with Some(window); four fields kept in step by hand
fix: enum CallWindow { Closed, Opening{stream}, Open{handle, stream, visible} }.

title: Stream join as stream_join + stream_joining + stream_join_timeout
trigger: Press Watch/Join on a live stream
effect: Three Options that must be set and cleared together (timeout task is dropped in six places by hand)
fix: enum StreamJoin { Idle, Wanted{intent, tracked_then}, Joining{call, timeout: Task} }.

title: A join intent noted before fetch_group_call is not cleared when the fetch fails
trigger: Press the voice chat button, fetch_group_call returns Err (note says could not reach); later join that same call another way
effect: stream_join stays set until a call is tracked, then the window auto-joins the stream the user gave up on
fix: Note the intent only after the send succeeded, or clear it in the Err arm.

title: Rename box is closed before the rename is sent, so a failed send loses the typed title
trigger: Open Rename voice chat, type a title, Save while set_video_chat_title returns Err or there is no live client
effect: Box closes with an error note; the typed title is gone and must be retyped
fix: Take the dialog out only on Ok; put it back on Err (as restrict/permissions boxes do).

title: In-call composer text survives a change of call within the account
trigger: Type a message in call A's chat, leave A, join call B in the same account; the unsent text is still in the box and Send posts it to B
effect: A draft written for one call is sent to another; sync_group_call_boxes resets the rename box, invite, share and pin but not the composer
fix: Clear the composer in the same branch of sync_group_call_boxes that resets other per-call state (before != id).

title: Edit box closes as saved when a second Save fails to send
trigger: Save the group (title refused, box shows Failed), fix nothing and press Save again while save_group_type/save_group_info returns Err (InvalidRequest, no rights, send error)
effect: The first lines of save_group_type clear info_edit_errors; the Err arm keeps the old saving ids, which are answered; state() is now requests gone and no error = Saved, so group_edit_box() reports the box closed (shell closes it) with only an error toast and the edits lost
fix: Make saving an enum field Editing/Saving(ids)/Failed(reason); Err sets Failed in the box itself instead of leaving the old ids to be re-derived.

title: Edit box state ignores failures that record no error: photo upload, username premium limit, unknown username problems, type edits
trigger: Edit a group, pick a new photo (or a link that needs Premium) and Save; TDLib refuses the photo or link
effect: record_group_info_edit_error returns without storing for those purposes and state() excludes GroupInfoField::Photo, so the box counts as Saved and closes; nothing anywhere shows the photo error
fix: Track each sent request's result in the box (per-request outcome enum) rather than inferring success from the absence of an error entry.

title: A box derived as Saved is never removed and can reopen as Failed
trigger: Save succeeds (box closes); later another Manage action (upgrade, sign/translate toggle) records a Settings error for the same chat in info_edit_errors
effect: admin.group_edit_box still holds the old box with saving=Some(done ids); state() flips Saved -> Failed, group_edit_box() returns it again and the host reopens the Edit box with a stale reason
fix: Drop admin.group_edit_box (via close_group_edit_box) when the state becomes Saved, not just hide it.

title: Partial send on Save error leaves some edits applied but untracked
trigger: Save a title change plus a photo where the first request is sent and the next send returns Err
effect: save_group_info stops at the failed edit; what was sent stays sent but the box does not track those ids (saving not set on Err), so no Failed/Saving state shows for them and a retry resends
fix: Return the ids sent so far with the error and keep them in saving.

title: Edit box stage is saving + title_empty + title_emoji + type_box + history_box + photo/photo_note
trigger: Edit, Save, open sub boxes, emoji panel
effect: Stage is derived partly from the session (requests, errors) and partly from five fields in the box and the shared media panel; Saved is a derived state that is never applied
fix: enum EditBoxStage owned by the box: Editing{sub: None|Type|History|Emoji}, Saving(ids), Failed{field,reason}.

title: Title emoji panel is edit.title_emoji AND pickers.media_panel open, kept in step by hand
trigger: Open the name field emoji panel, close the panel with Esc/outside click, or let the box turn Saved
effect: title_emoji stays true after the shared panel closes; close_group_title_emoji only closes the panel when group_edit_box() is Some, so a box that became Saved while the panel was open leaves the panel open
fix: The panel's open state carries its owner (MediaPanelOwner::GroupTitle) in one value.

title: Sticker pack loading derived from request purposes plus stickers.failed flags
trigger: Press Load packs in the Edit box
effect: busy/loading come from has_purpose over two purposes and session.stickers.*.failed sits beside them; no stage enum
fix: Fetch<T> for each pack list.

title: Picked contacts are taken out of the Add members list before the send
trigger: Pick contacts in Add members and press Add while add_chat_members returns Err
effect: Selection is emptied (mem::take) and an error toast shows; user must pick everyone again
fix: Clear the selection only on Ok(Some).

title: Unban/kick refetch the member page right after sending, before the change applies
trigger: Unban a member in the Banned tab (or remove one from Add exception)
effect: refresh_supergroup_members clears the cache and asks again immediately; the page can come back with the member still there and nothing refetches after the status change lands
fix: Refetch on the answer to the set-status request (match by request id).

title: Promote, edit-rights and demote treat Ok(None) (driver refused) as success
trigger: Demote the owner or press Demote twice quickly (duplicate in flight); promote without the right
effect: submit_admin_dialog matches Ok(_): the dialog is dropped and the note says 'Admin demoted' / 'Member promoted' though nothing was sent (Restrict handles Ok(None) correctly)
fix: Match Ok(Some(_)) as success and keep the dialog with an error on Ok(None), as submit_restrict_dialog does.

title: Restrict, ban, promote and demote dialogs close on send, so a server refusal is not shown in the box
trigger: Ban or restrict a member who cannot be restricted (admin, rights changed); TDLib answers with an error
effect: Box has already closed with 'Member banned' note; failure surfaces only in member_action_error of the member dialog if it happens to be open
fix: Hold the dialog in a Sending(request id) stage and close it on the matching answer.

title: Permissions Save closes silently when nothing was sent
trigger: Change a permission and Save when set_chat_permissions refuses (no right, same request in flight)
effect: save_permissions_box returns Ok(false) for 'nothing differs or the viewer may not save'; the box closes with no note, the change is lost
fix: Distinguish Unchanged from Refused in the return type and keep the box with an error on Refused.

title: Permissions Save sends the permissions then fails on slow mode and restores the box
trigger: Change permissions and slow mode, Save when set_chat_slow_mode_delay returns Err
effect: Permissions were already sent but the box is restored and an error toast says it failed; Save again compares against the new state
fix: Report which parts were sent and close/restore per part.

title: Boost list is loading + error + boosts + next_offset
trigger: Open Boosts, switch All/Gifts tab, press Show more
effect: Page stage read from state.loading, state.error and next_offset together (error and loading can both be set); tab is state.only_gifts set by the request, not by the page
fix: Fetch<Page> with a tab key (BoostTab) carried by the request and checked on the answer.

title: Push-to-talk hook as ptt_capture + global_ptt_polling + global_ptt_listener_stop + global_ptt
trigger: Join a call with push-to-talk, rebind the key, leave
effect: Two bools and an Option kept in step with the controller; bound by hand in sync_global_ptt
fix: enum PttHook { Off, Capturing, Listening{stop} }.

title: Manage Topics dialog Delete button deletes a topic and all its messages with no confirmation
trigger: Open a forum's Manage Topics dialog (admin), click Delete on any non-General topic row.
effect: deleteForumTopic is sent at once and the topic with every message in it is gone; the context-menu path asks GroupConfirm::DeleteForumTopic first, this one does not. The note says 'Topic updated'.
fix: Route ForumTopicAction::Delete through open_group_confirm(DeleteForumTopic) like the topic menu; keep forum_topic_action for the non-destructive actions.

title: Topic editor closes as saved when the create/edit request failed
trigger: In the topic editor type a name, press Create/Save while the send fails (driver Err, or no live client).
effect: editor is set to None after the error note, so the typed name and chosen icon are lost and the list shows again as if saved.
fix: Clear the editor only in the Ok arm (or hold it as an enum Editing/Saving/Failed); keep it on Err.

title: Dialog builder asks for topic icon downloads on every build while the editor is open
trigger: Open the topic editor and leave it open.
effect: download_forum_topic_icons runs inside the dialog builder, a render-time side effect; each rebuild re-requests downloads for every icon file.
fix: Request the downloads once in begin_topic_editor (or when the icon list lands), not in the builder.

title: Topic info toggle is a bare bool on ChatUi
trigger: Click the topic info button in the topic strip.
effect: chat_ui.topic_info_open is flipped by hand and is not tied to the open topic; it stays set when the user selects another topic or leaves to the topic list.
fix: Make it part of an enum of the thread view (TopicList / Topic{id, info_open}) so leaving the topic drops it.

title: forum_chats_peek and forum_column_shown are two bools kept in step by the render path
trigger: Open a forum chat, press 'Chats' to peek, then resize the window or open a non-forum chat.
effect: forum_column_layout (called while rendering, takes &mut self) both resets forum_chats_peek and records forum_column_shown; derived state written every frame and the peek ends only when something renders.
fix: One enum ForumColumnState {Hidden, Column, Peek} in ChatUi, derived from the layout in one place, not written from render.

title: Selecting a topic flushes the draft and forgets scroll before the select can fail
trigger: Click a topic row while select_topic returns Err.
effect: The leaving draft is flushed and the target topic's scroll memory forgotten, then an error note shows and the old view stays; draft restore runs for a view that did not change.
fix: Do the flush/forget after select_topic returns Ok.

title: Welcome message text cleared even when the add failed
trigger: Type a welcome message, press Add while the request fails (driver Err or no live client).
effect: new_input is reset to empty after the error note, so the typed message is lost.
fix: Clear the input only in the Ok arm.

title: Welcome message edit closes as saved when the edit failed
trigger: Press Edit on a welcome message, change the text, press Save while the request fails.
effect: editing is set to None after the error note, the edit text is dropped and the row shows the old text as if saved.
fix: Leave editing set on Err; model the dialog row as Viewing/Editing{id}/Saving{id}.

title: Retry in the welcome dialog rebuilds the dialog and drops typed text
trigger: Type a new welcome message, load fails, press Retry.
effect: open_welcome_dialog replaces the whole WelcomeDialog (new inputs), so the typed text and an open edit are lost.
fix: Retry should only re-request load_chat_welcome_messages for the open dialog.

title: Welcome edit target is an Option<i32> not tied to the loaded list
trigger: Start editing a welcome message that is then deleted or replaced by an update.
effect: dialog.editing keeps pointing at an id that may be gone; Save sends editChatWelcomeMessage for a missing id and nothing on screen shows the edit.
fix: Drop editing when the id leaves welcome_messages, or hold the edited message's id and text in one enum variant.

title: Promote picker keeps a selection that the search results no longer show
trigger: Open Promote admin, tick member A, type another name and press Search so A is not in the new page, then press Promote.
effect: No radio is selected (selected_ix is None) but selected_user is still A and the Promote button stays enabled, so A is promoted to administrator with the rights shown, unseen.
fix: Clear selected_user in search_promote_members, and enable Promote only when selected_user is among the candidates shown (derive from the page, not stored).

title: Promote picker 'searched' is set when the search is sent, not when the page lands
trigger: Open Promote admin, type a query and press Search while offline or slow.
effect: The panel switches to the Search page key at once; it shows the previous Search page (cache key is chat+filter, not the query) or Loading, so rows of an older query appear under the new text. Not matched to the query that asked.
fix: Key the member page by (chat, filter, query) and set searched from the answer's query.

title: Stops slider thumb stays on a value the save refused
trigger: Drag the slow mode (or boosters) slider and release; the change request fails or the permission is refused and the caller's value does not change.
effect: on_change fires once on release; reported equals the caller's value so no resync happens, the thumb and the highlighted label stay on the unsaved stop while the real value is the old one.
fix: Resync the thumb whenever the caller's value differs from the slider's stop, not only when the caller's value changes; or make the pending drag an explicit variant.

title: reported, slider and release subscription are three keyed states kept in step by render
trigger: Render the slider; change the value from outside.
effect: reported mirrors the caller value, the slider holds the thumb, the subscription holds a clone of reported; correctness depends on the order of updates in render. Keyed by (kind, chat) only, so two windows of one chat share names but not state.
fix: One keyed state enum Synced(value) / Dragging(position).

title: save_refused flag and version counter drive the link status line
trigger: Press Save with an empty or bad link, then switch Public to Private and back.
effect: save_refused is a bool cleared only by a link edit; it stays set when the user flips Public/Private so the empty link shows 'too short' again without a new Save press. version is a keystroke token for the timer.
fix: Fold into one LinkCheck enum (Idle, Typed{version}, Refused{version}) cleared by choose_group_public too.

title: Choosing Public at the links limit leaves draft.public set while the box shows Private
trigger: Open Type box at the public links limit, click Public (limit box opens), dismiss it.
effect: draft.public is true but public_blocked hides it; if a link is freed later the box flips to Public with a link check the user did not choose. Save handles blocked correctly.
fix: Do not store the blocked choice; keep draft.public false until the limit clears.

title: Apply-to-invite-links alert answer is not matched to the type box that asked
trigger: Press Save in the Type box with join-approval changed, leave the alert open, close the Edit box (chat removed or window closed), open another group's Type box, then answer the alert.
effect: finish_group_type_box(Some(..)) applies to whatever type box is open now, not the chat that asked.
fix: Carry (chat_id, box token) in the alert and compare before finishing.

title: Username toggle error from an earlier try shows when the Type box is reopened
trigger: Toggle a username to active when at the limit (error shown), close the Type box, reopen it for the same chat.
effect: Session group_type.toggle_error is a single global slot, cleared only when a new toggle starts, so the old 'too many usernames' line appears on reopen.
fix: Clear the error in open_group_type_box and when the box closes, or keep it inside GroupTypeBox.

title: Show/hide username alert answer is not matched to the box that asked
trigger: Click a username, leave the alert open, close the Edit box and reopen it, answer the alert.
effect: toggle_group_type_username sends for the captured chat/name even if the box is no longer for that chat or the username list changed.
fix: Check that the Type box for chat_id is still open before sending.

title: Bulk 'delete chats' acts on the selection at submit time, not the one the user confirmed
trigger: Select chats, press Delete, and while the confirm box is open the list changes (a selected chat is archived or removed, another listed chat arrives and is re-listed in the selection).
effect: selected_chat_ids() is recomputed in submit_group_confirm; the confirm text names no chats and the enum is Copy, so the set deleted is whatever is selected then. Also the note reports success when 0 requests were sent.
fix: Carry the chat ids in the confirm variant (Vec) and show the count; report an error when none was sent.

title: Leave/Delete chat reports success and closes the Edit box when the request was only sent
trigger: Confirm Delete chat or Leave chat while TDLib then refuses (not allowed, flood).
effect: Note says 'Chat deleted' / 'Left the chat' and the Edit box is closed at dispatch; the failure (if surfaced) arrives later as a separate error and the box is gone.
fix: Show 'Deleting...' and close the Edit box from the chat's removal update, not from the send result.

title: Custom title / community name box closes as saved on dispatch
trigger: Edit an admin custom title and press Save; TDLib then rejects the change.
effect: Dialog is dropped when the request is sent and the note says 'Custom title updated'; the rejection arrives later and the typed title is lost.
fix: Hold the box as Editing/Saving{request}/Failed and close it on the answer.

title: UsernameDialog carries a community id in a ChatId field
trigger: Open Rename community.
effect: UsernameDialog.chat_id is ChatId(community_id) with the real id also inside TextPromptKind::CommunityName; the kinds of id share one field and one dialog slot for two unrelated prompts.
fix: Put the owner inside TextPromptKind (CustomTitle{chat,user} / CommunityName{community}) and drop chat_id.

title: Group confirm is one session-wide slot with chat_id plus an action
trigger: Open any confirm (delete chat, block, delete topic) from the main window then another from a chat window.
effect: GroupConfirmDialog{chat_id, action} uses ChatId(0) for actions with no chat (DeleteContact, BlockContact, ClearPaymentInfo) and a second opener overwrites the first.
fix: Make the action carry its own target (no ChatId(0) placeholder) and own the dialog per window.

title: New community box closes as created on dispatch
trigger: Fill the New community box and press Create; create_community returns Ok(Some) but TDLib then refuses.
effect: The dialog is taken and dropped on the send result, the note says 'Community created'; a later refusal leaves the user with no box and the typed name lost.
fix: Keep the box as Submitting{request} and close it on the answer.

title: close_info_panel does not close the pieces opened with the panel
trigger: Open a supergroup info panel (inline members, event-log search field), close it, open a user panel.
effect: Only the driver target and common_groups are reset; inline_members and admin.event_log_search keep their state and the event-log field keeps the old chat's query until the next open syncs it.
fix: Have one InfoPanelUi value that is replaced on open/close and owns these sub-states.

title: Opening an info panel with a failed fetch still leaves the target set
trigger: Open a user or group panel while the fetch request returns Err.
effect: Target is already set in the driver and the error note is shown; the panel draws empty with no retry path other than closing and reopening.
fix: Model the panel as Fetch<T> so the failure is drawn with a Retry.

title: Share link sets a session-wide share target from a chat window profile
trigger: Right-click the group link in a profile modal and choose Share.
effect: self.share.link_text is session-wide (main window state); the chooser opens in the window of the last press, not necessarily the window that asked.
fix: Use the Asker seam to name the window for the share box.
